summary: A clearer Tools › Options in a window of its own, servers you can arrange that reopen as you left them, IntelliSense that ranks exact matches first, quicker Peek and new editor commands, and keyboard and multi-column filtering in the results.

changes.title: A clearer Tools › Options
changes.text: Every page lines its labels, fields and lists up in columns, and longer pages group their settings under headings, such as Results to Grid's Grid display, Copy and save, Limits and memory, and Execution plan. Units and hints such as "0 = no limit" sit beside the field, and searching a heading's name finds its settings.

changes.title: Options and About in their own windows
changes.text: Tools › Options and Help › About open in themed windows of their own that you can move anywhere, even to another monitor. Options can be resized, opens at the size you last left it, and lets you keep working in the main window while it is open.

changes.title: Arrange your servers
changes.text: Drag servers in Object Explorer to reorder them, or use Move Up and Move Down (Alt+Up and Alt+Down). The order is kept across restarts.

changes.title: Object Explorer opens as you left it
changes.text: Servers that reconnect at startup expand only the nodes you had open when you closed Varia, instead of every server expanding.

changes.title: Quicker Peek
changes.text: Holding Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) over Object Explorer shows a zoom cursor on rows you can peek, and pressing it with the pointer already resting on a row peeks it without moving the mouse. Releasing it keeps the card open so you can move into it.

changes.title: Toggle Brackets
changes.text: Ctrl+[ (Cmd+[ on macOS), the editor's context menu or Edit › Advanced brackets every name in the selection or the whole query, or takes the brackets off again where they are not needed. Strings, comments, variables and keywords are never touched.

changes.title: Commas to front or end
changes.text: Move Commas to Front and Move Commas to End restyle SELECT lists, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, INSERT column lists, VALUES and parameter lists in the selection or the current statement, keeping trailing comments in place.

changes.title: Filter for Selected Values across columns
changes.text: Select cells in several columns, side by side or with Ctrl+click, and Filter for Selected Values (and Exclude Selected Values or Filter Between Lowest and Highest Selected) adds one filter per column from the cells selected in it, and a row must pass every column's filter.

changes.title: A keyboard-driven column filter list
changes.text: In the list Alt+Down opens, Down moves from the search into the values, the arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End move through them, Space ticks or unticks one and Enter filters. Screen readers hear it as a list of checkable options.

changes.title: Peek from the query editor
changes.text: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) and rest the pointer on a table or other object name to Peek it in a card beside the name, as in Object Explorer. Alt+F12 opens the same card at the caret, and Ctrl+click now opens a Peek tab instead of scripting the object; F12 still scripts it as CREATE.

changes.title: Room for documents that are not queries
changes.text: Activity Monitor, Properties, Table Designer, the SSIS pages and values opened from the results now fill the document area instead of sharing it with an empty Results pane. The Results pane comes back at its size when you switch to a query; panels you moved, floated or popped out stay where they are.

changes.title: Connection labels update at once
changes.text: Changing a saved connection's name, color, environment or startup reconnect in Connect now updates its Object Explorer connection, query tabs and status bar straight away, without disconnecting and connecting again. Connect no longer asks whether to use labels you just changed, and changes only those.

changes.title: No more lost connection edits
changes.text: Save moves to Connect's footer beside Connect and Cancel. Closing Connect with unsaved changes to a saved connection asks whether to save them.

changes.title: Sorting a compressed result keeps it compressed
changes.text: Sorting or filtering a result that was compressed while shown no longer decompresses all of it afterwards, so the memory it saved stays saved.

changes.title: IntelliSense ranks exact matches first and brackets columns consistently
changes.text: A name you type exactly, in any case, is now first in the completion list instead of below names that only start with it, fuzzy matches or system objects, and it is no longer missing from the visible list. Every column suggestion shows and inserts its bracketed name, so a column of the alias `[bob]` inserts `[bob].[columnName]` just as the list shows.
